scope_summary: GoPay Consumer Birthday Feature (Project Aura): KYC-verified users with a confirmed DOB see a birthday Genie card on Home V3.1 on their birthday D-Day. Tapping the card launches a full-screen Lottie celebration animation, an intermediary blow-candle screen, and a 10-card selection gallery. The selected card can be saved and shared via WhatsApp and Instagram Stories. All screen content (texts, assets, background colors) is Litmus-driven. Feature has no API changes — pure Litmus + FE local cache implementation. plan_context.json was not provided; test hooks and code-change view models are excluded.
risk_assessment: RISK-001 (High): Litmus is not birthday-date-aware. Birthday gating depends entirely on BE Genie/PN trigger. FE has no date guard — a cached deeplink could theoretically open the flow on a non-birthday day.
RISK-002 (High): Litmus one-session-late staleness — first cold launch on birthday may serve stale (pre-birthday) Litmus snapshot. Not mitigated in RFC. Manual test required.
RISK-003 (Low): Display name from AuthSDK cache may be stale if user recently updated profile name. Accepted tradeoff per RFC.
RISK-004 (Medium): Cache invalidation strategy for birthday Litmus payload and selected card ID is undefined (OQ-010 OPEN). Stale birthday content risk on non-birthday days.
PRD vs RFC High drift: PRD implies BE/server-side persistence for selected card ('saved to user profile'). RFC implements FE-local cache/persistence only. Must be resolved before release.
PRD vs RFC Medium drift: PRD sharing scope is WhatsApp-only. RFC scope includes IG, TikTok, link share. MVP sharing scope must be clarified with PM.

Design blocking issue: ANIMATION_FLASH → BIRTHDAY_RESULT prototype connector is null (broken). Post-candle transition not prototyped. PUSH_NOTIFICATION frame has no prototype connectors to birthday flow.

prd_vs_figma_gaps.gap_description: Lottie animation exit CTA (Gamified skip button, Figma id 7222:34856) has ON_CLICK → null in the prototype. Skip/exit behavior during animation is undefined in Figma. Implementation decision required: does tapping skip navigate to HAPPY_BIRTHDAY, exit the birthday flow entirely, or advance to BIRTHDAY_RESULT?

No dedicated re-trigger flow is prototyped in Figma. The path where card selection is skipped and the previously selected card is shown has no design representation. Test execution for TC-007 and TC-014 depends entirely on dev implementation, not any Figma spec.

PUSH_NOTIFICATION frame (Figma 7009:8321) has no prototype connectors to any birthday flow screen. The deeplink routing spec from PN tap to celebration animation is missing from both the Figma prototype and the RFC (deep_link: null for all navigation_changes entries).

ANIMATION_FLASH (Figma 7222:34944) AFTER_TIMEOUT connector has destinationId=null. The post-candle-tap transition to BIRTHDAY_RESULT card selection is broken in the prototype. Automation for TC-006 must rely on dev-implemented navigation, not Figma connector.

Design prototypes only WhatsApp (WHATSAPP_CHAT) and Instagram Stories (INSTA_STORIES) share paths. No TikTok or link-share UI is designed. RFC mentions onboarding module dependency for IG/TikTok. MVP sharing scope must be clarified before additional share-path test cases are written.

prd_vs_rfc_gaps.gap_description: High severity drift: PRD states selected card is 'saved to user profile' (implies server-side BE persistence). RFC implements birthday_selected_card_id as FE-local PERSISTENCE key only — no BE sync. If BE persistence is required, the RFC is incomplete and BE work is missing. PM and dev must align before release.

Medium severity drift: PRD sharing scope is WhatsApp-only. RFC includes native popup, direct-to-platform IG/TikTok, and link share. Expanded sharing scope introduces an unresolved dependency on the onboarding module. MVP sharing scope must be clarified with PM.

Low severity: PRD lists platforms as [android, ios] separately. RFC implements as Flutter (single cross-platform build). No functional impact but test matrix must explicitly cover both platform flavors.

Low severity: PRD has no named feature flags. RFC uses Litmus release ID as gate (birthday_feature_litmus_content). QA environment must use integration Litmus release 19d9e576-5789-4d69-9b78-ca0e76304674.

missing_hooks: No deeplink defined for any birthday flow screen in RFC (deep_link: null for all navigation_changes). Direct deeplink entry to LOTTIE_ANIMATION, HAPPY_BIRTHDAY, or BIRTHDAY_RESULT is not possible. All test entry must go through HOMESCREEN Genie card tap or PN tap.
No test override for Litmus content injection at screen level. To test Litmus failure scenarios, a mock Litmus server or Litmus content reset tool is required.
No method to time-travel the birthday_today BE segment for a test account without coordination with the BE team. Birthday D-Day tests require pre-scheduled test account setup.

No FE-level date override hook to simulate birthday vs non-birthday day without BE dependency. Tests requiring specific date conditions (BC-001 window boundary) require manual time manipulation or coordinated BE segment control.
audioplayer package feasibility unconfirmed — no test hook for sound effect verification. Sound playback tests are blocked until the package is confirmed and an audio capture mechanism is available.

unclear_ac: BR-002: Animation exit CTA destination is undefined. What screen does tapping skip/exit during the animation navigate to? Cannot write a complete TC-004 expected result without this answer.

BR-002: Animation duration and auto-advance timeout value are not defined in PRD or RFC. AFTER_TIMEOUT trigger in Figma has no delay value. Tests for TC-003 cannot validate timing without a defined timeout.

BR-003: The blow candle screen is described as non-skippable in BC-003 MVP, but RFC notes this is deferred to next iteration. Is the skip/timeout behavior on HAPPY_BIRTHDAY screen also undefined for MVP?
BR-006: PN deeplink URL scheme and parameters are not defined in the RFC (deep_link: null). What is the FE deeplink that the PN payload routes to? TC-008 cannot be fully specified without this.
BR-007: WhatsApp pre-filled message copy is TBD/pending approval. TC-009 expected result verification of message copy is blocked.
OQ-003 (OPEN): Dark mode handling for birthday screens is undefined. Dark mode test cases cannot be scoped.
OQ-010 (OPEN): Cache invalidation strategy after 24-hour window is undefined. TC-012 post-window state verification has incomplete acceptance criteria.
RISK-004: No acceptance criteria defined for what 'cache cleared' means — is it on OS midnight, on next app launch after midnight, or on explicit TTL expiry?
